name: Chain of Appetite
description: Feed matching two-colour creatures along clear rows and columns until exactly one survivor remains.
natural_language: Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Programs in an isolated agent sandbox may process screenshots and issue mouse and keyboard actions through the provided gateway. Do not access the task environment through Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network or source inspection, DOM or page-state inspection, the task terminal or shell, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden state, or unrelated tabs. Reduce the tray from twelve creatures to one. A mouth may eat a matching body along a clear row or column; the eater inherits the eaten creature's mouth colour.

metadata.source_notes: SmartGamesLive Monsters and its Messy Monsters remake contribute unobstructed orthogonal jumps, mouth-to-body colour matching, inherited victim mouth colour, one-survivor success, and deadlock failure. The backward generator, specimen art, canteen interface, controllability profiles, solver, and independent replay grader are original.
metadata.notes: Instances are constructed backward from one survivor and independently replayed. Public state includes the visible tray but not a solution or deadlock path. Server and exported verifier replay every meal, colour inheritance, line obstruction, input surface, final tray, and challenge identity.
